text: {"sql":"SELECT ROUND((SUM(oi.amount) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.cost)) / SUM(oi.amount) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('已取消', '已退款')","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
